description: This file defines interfaces and data structures related to object identification and name resolution within a version control system, likely Git. It includes function declarations for object ID abbreviation, object retrieval, branch name interpretation, and object peeling.

classes.name: object_context
classes.description: Structure representing the context of a Git object, including mode, symlink path, and optional record of the resolved path.

classes.name: interpret_branch_name_options
classes.description: Options for interpreting branch names, including allowed namespace bits and handling of dangling references.

methods.name: object_context_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with an object_context.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Returns an abbreviated SHA1 unique within the repository's object database.

methods.name: repo_find_unique_abbrev_r
methods.description: Reentrant version of repo_find_unique_abbrev, writes to caller-supplied buffer.

methods.name: strbuf_repo_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds a unique abbreviation of a SHA1 to a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_add_unique_abbrev
methods.description: Adds a unique abbreviation of a SHA1 to a strbuf.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_with_flags
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID based on a string expression with flags.

methods.name: repo_get_oid
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID based on a string expression.

methods.name: get_oidf
methods.description: Formatted version of get_oid, with printf-style arguments.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_commit
methods.description: Retrieves a commit object ID based on a string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_committish
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID that can be a commit or similar.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_tree
methods.description: Retrieves a tree object ID based on a string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_treeish
methods.description: Retrieves a tree-ish object ID.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_blob
methods.description: Retrieves a blob object ID based on a string.

methods.name: repo_get_oid_mb
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID based on a string, possibly a merge base.

methods.name: maybe_die_on_misspelt_object_name
methods.description: Checks for misspelled object names and possibly terminates.

methods.name: get_oid_with_context
methods.description: Retrieves an object ID with additional context and flags.

methods.name: repo_for_each_abbrev
methods.description: Iterates over all abbreviations matching a prefix.

methods.name: set_disambiguate_hint_config
methods.description: Sets configuration for disambiguation hints.

methods.name: repo_interpret_branch_name
methods.description: Interprets branch name expressions, such as '@{-N}' or 'branch@{upstream}'.

methods.name: repo_peel_to_type
methods.description: Peels an object to a specific type.
